name: ez-dev
description: EZ DEV — parent platform for EZ APP (AI app builder), EZ SITE (AI website builder) and EZ DEFENDER (security toolbox), on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/configure.mjs && for a in ezdev ezapp ezsite ezdefender; do npx wrangler@4 deploy -c apps/$a/wrangler.json || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply ez-dev-db --remote -c apps/ezdev/wrangler.json
